# Much faster module deletes, and a run log you can export

Anaplan Toolkit 2.10.0 makes whole-module deletes about **5x faster** and stops the delete from spending minutes on modules Anaplan will refuse. On the same 11,197-line-item / 520-module cleanup, a run went from **31 minutes to 6**, with no refused calls.

## Improvements

- **Modules go up to 10 to a request** (Delete Items with *whole modules* ticked). Modules that no pending line item uses are sent together, one `DeleteModule` change each - the same request Anaplan's own dialog makes. A refused request is not split in halves (a refusal can take a minute to come back): its modules go one request each, so only the module Anaplan keeps pays for it.
- **Modules a process uses are no longer attempted.** Check already lists them; they are now kept without a call, shown in Skipped as *Module kept* with their process under *Delete these processes first*, and their line items are deleted one by one. On a live run each refusal cost about 50 seconds (15 of them: 14 minutes). Delete the process, then delete the module with Delete Modules.
- **Run log**: *Export log* (and the auto-save) writes one row per request - when, how long, what, applied / refused, Anaplan's reason, serial before and after - beside the report as `…-log.csv`. The status line shows the time Anaplan took and the slowest call.
- **Pause** keeps saying *Pausing…* while the call in flight finishes instead of falling back to *Pause* after 8 seconds.
- Both delete views: a clearer start screen, a live-region progress list, and a call in flight past a minute is flagged as slow.

## Fixes and housekeeping

- Lock Monitor: a crash in its loop is shown in the panel instead of leaving it silently dead.
- Delete reports: the panel refuses a delete request whose rows are not a list of objects.
- The panel and Summary no longer re-render every 30 seconds while hidden.
- Accessibility: visible keyboard focus, slower (not stopped) spinners under reduced motion, arrow / Home / End keys on the tab bars.
- Removed the dead popup and two retired view snapshots from the package; a new CI check parses every script and builds the packages.

## Permissions

- No new permissions. `downloads` (optional, auto-saving the delete report) and `notifications` (optional, Lock Monitor) are unchanged.

## Install

- **Chrome / Edge**: `anaplan-toolkit.zip` - unzip, then `chrome://extensions` → Developer mode → *Load unpacked*.
- **Firefox 140+**: `anaplan-toolkit-firefox.zip` - `about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox` → *Load Temporary Add-on*.

After updating, reload any open Anaplan tabs.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/umang350/AnaplanToolkit/compare/2.9.0...2.10.0
